title: Independent held-out questions for the task-grouped platform FAQ expansion

policy.independence: Written from routes, forms, views, templates and README before reading the expanded assistant knowledge examples.
policy.topic_mapping: Concept names describe intent, not required implementation IDs; map semantically equivalent new topic IDs at first evaluation.
policy.correct_direct_answer: Must address the user question and satisfy required facts without any prohibited claim. A correct generic topic label is not enough.
policy.useful_clarification: A correct candidate may defer the answer, with at most four choices; complete expected concept sets are required for intentionally ambiguous prompts.
policy.matching_vs_facts: Report direct-answer factual accuracy separately from candidate coverage and strict expected mode.
policy.security: Evaluate only through isolated DEBUG=True SQLite fixtures; no real user data or external services.

turns.question: Do I have to give you my email address to make a login?
required_facts: Email is optional for platform registration.
The pilot has no email verification or email password recovery.
must_not_claim: Email is required.
An activation email will be sent.

turns.question: 注册用户名里想写王同学加一个空格，为什么不让过？
required_facts: Usernames do not allow spaces.
Valid usernames are unique ignoring case and limited to 150 characters.
must_not_claim: Any display name can be used as a username with spaces.

turns.question: Does my pasword really need a capital letter and a symbol?
required_facts: At least eight characters.
No mandatory uppercase/lowercase/symbol mixture.
All numeric, common or too similar passwords are rejected.
must_not_claim: A symbol and uppercase character are compulsory.

turns.question: 我换了单位，页面上个人简介的机构去哪里改？
required_facts: Account Settings has an editable optional Institution field.
Save changes applies the profile update.
must_not_claim: Edit the uploaded JSON to change the account institution.

turns.question: If I shut Chrome and open it tomorrow, will the site have logged me out even without remember me?
required_facts: Without Remember me an ordinary login lasts 30 days and survives browser restart.
It has a fixed deadline; clearing cookies or explicit logout can end it earlier.
must_not_claim: Unchecked Remember me means browser-session-only login.

turns.question: 勾上记住我以后，只是让网页一直开着就能自动续一年吗？
required_facts: Remember me provides a 365-day persistent session.
Successful ordinary page visits renew at most once per day.
Background refresh alone does not renew it.
must_not_claim: Keeping the tab open guarantees indefinite access.

turns.question: I lost the password and the forgot-password text does nothing. Where is the reset email?
required_facts: Email password recovery is unavailable in the pilot.
Changing a usable local password normally requires the current password.
must_not_claim: A reset email can be requested here.
ORCID sign-in resets or bypasses the current local password.

turns.question: 还记得旧密码，只是想换一个。在哪里操作？
required_facts: Account Settings offers Change password.
Enter current password and the new password twice.

turns.question: 那原来的忘了呢？
required_facts: There is no email password recovery in this pilot.
ORCID does not make the old-password requirement disappear.
must_not_claim: The user can use Change password without knowing the current usable password.

turns.question: I already uploaded with a normal login. How do I add my researcher iD without ending up with another empty account?
required_facts: Sign in to the existing platform account first.
Use Account Settings → Connect ORCID.
An unlinked ORCID login may create a separate account.
must_not_claim: Matching email automatically merges accounts.

turns.question: 用 ORCID 登进来后以前上传的东西没了，邮箱还是同一个，会自动合并回来吗？
required_facts: Same name or email does not merge platform accounts.
Unlinked ORCID sign-in can create a different account.
Previously uploaded data stays with the original owner account.
must_not_claim: Uploads have been deleted.
Accounts merge after email verification.

turns.question: Why is it asking me to choose another password when I just authenticated at ORCID?
required_facts: An ORCID-only platform account must choose its platform username and local password twice before entering.
This does not change ORCID credentials.
The account, uploaded data and ORCID connection are retained.
must_not_claim: Enter the ORCID password into the platform form.
Skip setup and continue normally.

turns.question: 把研究者账号解绑会连同我的上传记录一起删掉吗？
required_facts: Disconnect only removes the verified ORCID link.
The platform account, uploads and local credentials remain.

turns.question: 之后还怎么登录？
required_facts: Use the retained platform username and password after disconnecting ORCID.
must_not_claim: The disconnected ORCID still signs in to the same account automatically.

turns.question: It says this iD belongs to my other account. Can I attach it here as well?
required_facts: One verified ORCID iD can be linked to only one platform account.
Disconnect it from the other account before connecting it here.
must_not_claim: The same iD may remain linked to both accounts.
The assistant can merge the accounts.

turns.question: ORCID 里面明明有单位，为什么这里机构还是空的？
required_facts: Only available public profile information fills empty optional fields.
Ambiguous or incompatible employment information may be left blank.
Existing local values are preserved and users can edit profile fields manually.
must_not_claim: All private ORCID information is imported.
A blank institution means sign-in failed.

turns.question: ORICD sign-in was cancelled and I am back at the login screen. Did that create a connection?
required_facts: Cancelled or failed authorization does not establish a verified ORCID connection.
Start sign-in or connection again from the appropriate page.
must_not_claim: Cancellation successfully links the account.
Paste a password or authorization token into chat.

turns.question: Trying to invite my coworker by her email, but Add user cannot find her. What should I type?
required_facts: Use the existing platform username, not an email address.
Only the owner can share a private object with another platform user.
must_not_claim: Email invitations create a platform account.

turns.question: 已经把同事从共享名单移除了，为什么发出的分享记录还留着？
required_facts: Sharing History records sent sharing events and is not the current permission list.
Remove stops that user’s current shared access.
The object detail page shows the current sharing list.
must_not_claim: History presence proves that access is still active.

turns.question: I sent a Public object URL to someone outside the site and it asks them to sign in. Is that expected?
required_facts: Public means available to other signed-in platform users.
It does not allow anonymous access.
must_not_claim: Anyone on the internet can open public objects without login.

turns.question: 已经传好的私有数据，现在在哪个按钮改成公开？
required_facts: The current UI does not offer a public/private switch for an existing object.
Detail sharing controls add or remove named users for a private object.
must_not_claim: There is a Change access dropdown on the detail page.
The assistant has made the object public.

turns.question: Public means I can republish the dataset under any licence, right?
required_facts: Platform access does not grant a reuse or copyright license.
Check the supplied rights metadata separately.
must_not_claim: Public access waives copyright.

turns.question: 别人分享给我的那份，我能再在站内加一个查看人吗？
required_facts: Only the owner can manage sharing.
Being a shared recipient does not make the user the owner.
must_not_claim: All viewers can add recipients.

turns.question: Will the bell tell me whenever somebody publishes a new public dataset?
required_facts: Notifications are created by explicit sharing of private data with the user.
Public uploads are found through Search or Live Data Objects, not per-upload notifications.
must_not_claim: Every public upload creates a notification for all users.

turns.question: 通知那里“全部已读”会把别人给我的数据删了吗？
required_facts: Mark all read only changes notification read status.
It does not delete data or revoke shared access.
must_not_claim: Marking read removes shared data.

turns.question: An old sharing alert opens a not-found page, but the alert is still there. What happened?
required_facts: Opening a notification checks current object access.
The owner may have removed shared access; a stale alert does not preserve it.
The assistant cannot grant access.
must_not_claim: The notification bypasses current permissions.
The object definitely still exists or definitely was deleted.

turns.question: 想看谁给我分享过东西，跟我发给别人的记录是在一个地方吗？
required_facts: Share has Shared with Me for accessible private objects shared by others.
Sharing History lists outgoing share events.
must_not_claim: Sharing History is the list of current recipients only.

turns.question: The detail list hides the big stress array. Will Download JSON leave that out too?
required_facts: Download JSON preserves the complete stored object including stress, strain and boundary data omitted from metadata display.
Original keys and values are preserved.
must_not_claim: The omitted display arrays are removed from JSON export.

turns.question: 勾了三条模拟记录下载曲线，为什么得到的是压缩包而不是一个表？
required_facts: One selected object downloads one CSV.
Multiple selected objects download a ZIP containing one CSV per object.
The data is not combined into one cross-object table.
must_not_claim: A multi-object CSV merges all samples into one physically comparable dataset.

turns.question: The last rows of one CSV column are blank while another continues. Has export thrown away my measurements?
required_facts: Unequal-length arrays retain every value.
Shorter columns end in blank cells without interpolation or resampling.
The index is array position, not a measured time.
must_not_claim: Blank values are measurements of zero.
Arrays are truncated to the shortest length.

turns.question: CSV 列名里的 calculated 是谁计算的，原来上传的数被覆盖了？
required_facts: Calculated equivalent curves are labelled.
Supplied equivalent arrays take precedence; only absent equivalent fields can use the existing complete-component calculations.
Stored and exported raw JSON is unchanged.
must_not_claim: All supplied curves are recalculated and overwrite raw JSON.

turns.question: One of my selected records has no curves. Can I still download the others as the same CSV batch?
required_facts: The whole selected curve download is rejected if any selected object lacks exportable curves or current access.
Change the selection and request the download again.
must_not_claim: CSV silently omits that record and downloads the rest.

turns.question: 搜索页批量下 JSON 时，一条的权限刚被收回，其他有权限的也全部下不了吗？
required_facts: Selected JSON export skips inaccessible or missing records and exports remaining accessible records.
It shows an error if no selected accessible objects remain.
This differs from the full-selection check for curve CSV.
must_not_claim: Any inaccessible selection always rejects the entire JSON export.

turns.question: Can this give me an xslx spreadsheet instead of csv?
required_facts: The current curve export format is UTF-8 CSV, with multiple objects in a ZIP.
There is no native Excel workbook export.
must_not_claim: There is an XLSX download button.

turns.question: 我把材料名字填错了，能直接在详情页改一下并覆盖原文件吗？
required_facts: There is no inline JSON data editor or overwrite action on the current detail page.
Duplicate identifiers are rejected rather than overwritten.
Original uploaded data is preserved.
must_not_claim: Edit the material field in the detail form.
Uploading the same identifier updates the existing record.

turns.question: I deleted an object by mistake. Where is its recycle bin?
required_facts: Deletion is owner-only.
The current platform has no recycle bin or self-service restore action.
Keep original files; do not promise recovery.
must_not_claim: Deleted records can be restored from a Recycle Bin page.

turns.question: 想把平台账号彻底注销，设置里哪个按钮？
required_facts: There is no self-service account deletion control in the current account settings.
Disconnecting ORCID does not delete the platform account.
must_not_claim: Click Delete account in Settings.
Disconnect ORCID deletes all uploads.

turns.question: Please fix the typo in my uploaded title and share the corrected record with Priya for me.
required_facts: The assistant provides prepared guidance and cannot edit uploaded data or execute sharing actions.
Only the owner can use the implemented sharing controls.
must_not_claim: The record has been changed or shared.
The assistant will generate a corrected file and upload it automatically.

turns.question: 上次跳过的新手步骤还能再看一遍吗？
required_facts: The top-bar help icon reopens the tour.
Quick start provides the core Search → Upload Data → My Data → Share guidance.
must_not_claim: The tour is permanently unavailable after Skip.

turns.question: I uploaded on localhost yesterday, but on the public site my account and files are missing. Does a push copy them over?
required_facts: Local and hosted accounts and data are separate.
Deploying or pushing code does not copy the local database and uploads to the hosted site.
must_not_claim: Git push copies local users and datasets to production.

turns.question: 传到这个网站后，本地原始文件可以删了长期只用网站备份吗？
required_facts: The pilot is not a permanent archive.
Keep original files and use test data as appropriate.
must_not_claim: The platform guarantees permanent archival preservation.

turns.question: Which download do I need?
required_facts: The response should ask what is needed or present the JSON and curve CSV alternatives.

turns.question: The whole original object, including every field.
required_facts: Download JSON gives the complete stored object, preserving original keys and values.
must_not_claim: Download CSV contains all nested JSON metadata.
